2: To the chief Musician. 'Destroy not.' Of David. Michtam; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from mine enemies, O myGod; secure me on high from them that rise up against me.
3: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from men of blood.
4: For behold, they lie in wait for my soul; strong ones are gathered against me: not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Jehovah.
5: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: awake to meet me, and behold.
6: Yea, do thou, Jehovah, theGod of hosts, theGod of Israel, arise to visit all the nations: be not gracious to any plotters of iniquity. Selah.
7: They return in the evening; they howl like a dog, and go round about the city:
8: Behold, they belch out with their mouth; swords are in their lips: for who [say they] doth hear?
9: But thou, Jehovah, wilt laugh at them; thou wilt have all the nations in derision.
10: Their strength!...I will take heed to thee; forGod is my high fortress.
11: God, whose loving-kindness will come to meet me, —God shall let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.
12: Slay them not, lest my people forget; by thy power make them wander, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
13: [Because of] the sin of their mouth, the word of their lips, let them even be taken in their pride; and because of cursing and lying which they speak.
14: Make an end in wrath, make an end, that they may be no more; that they may know thatGod ruleth in Jacob, unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
15: And in the evening they shall return, they shall howl like a dog, and go round about the city.
16: They shall wander about for meat, and stay all night if they be not satisfied.
17: But as for me, I will sing of thy strength; yea, I will sing aloud of thy loving-kindness in the morning; for thou hast been to me a high fortress, and a refuge in the day of my trouble.
18: Unto thee, my strength, will I sing psalms; forGod is my high fortress, theGod of my mercy.
